title: Rooftop star
text: You climbed the crates to the workshop roof! Fun fact: this whole island is made of code — no 3D models were harmed.

title: Hidden cave
text: You found the crystal cave. Fun fact: I write my best code after midnight.

title: First catch
text: You caught your first fish! Check your collection in the pause menu.

title: Goal!
text: You kicked the ball into the goal.

title: Went for a swim
text: You jumped into the sea. The water is lovely! Swim back to the beach or the dock to climb out.

title: Explorer
text: You visited every zone of the island.
